description: This file contains the implementation of the ServerStub class used for IPC testing in the Rialto project. It manages client connections, disconnections, and sending test events via a mock server, primarily for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: ServerStub
classes.description: A mock server stub class used for testing IPC communication, handling client connections, disconnections, and event sending.

methods.name: ServerStub::clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, resets connection state, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: ServerStub::clientConnected
methods.description: Handles client connection events, stores client info, exports services if mock is set, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: ServerStub::init
methods.description: Initializes the server, sets up socket, and starts the server processing thread.

methods.name: ServerStub::~ServerStub
methods.description: Destructor that joins the server thread if running.

methods.name: ServerStub::sendSingleVarEvent
methods.description: Creates and sends a single variable test event to the connected client.

methods.name: ServerStub::sendMultiVarEvent
methods.description: Creates and sends a multi-variable test event to the connected client.
